coded_by: AI agent (Claude), 2026-10-31; single coder; to be second-coded by a human
scope: PRs #64-#75 of nicolasbonilla/medical-imaging-viewer; sources: research/paper_h/data/github_prs_full_2026-10-31.json (PR bodies) and docs/iec62304/records at worktree HEAD (research/paper-h-manuscript, contains main @ 8805882)
severity_scheme: Severity kept as labelled by the source; only obvious synonyms mapped: 'Blocker.' / '(blocker)' / B-prefix ID -> blocker; 'major' / 'Major.' / '(major)' / 'R1 (major)' / M-prefix ID / verdict counts of 'majors' -> major; 'minor' / 'minor items' / 'minor points' / 'Known minor items' / m-prefix ID (incl. 'm-1') / verdict counts of 'minor' -> minor; 'nit' / n-prefix ID -> nit; anything else -> unlabelled. Exception: CAPA-014 §8.2 calls its R1-R4, M1, M2 'minor items', so M1/M2 there are minor. ID prefixes N, R, F, L, numbers, 'Also', 'film (a)' carry no severity. '(clinical safety)', 'pre-existing', 'Cosmetic', 'small items', 'Note', 'accepted' are not severity labels (kept in severity_as_written). Problem-report severities (SPR-001 Critical/Major/Minor) are a different scheme and are not used for review findings.
field_conventions: Each finding quote is an exact substring of the round 'source' unless the finding has its own 'source'. Optional round keys: reviewer_quote, label_quote (where the severity label is stated in another source), carried_over_not_counted. Top-level f08_provenance and excluded_items carry verified quotes too.

notes: SOURCE CHOICE: records preferred when they hold the round (PRB-002 §6; PRB-003 §9-§11 (duplicated in CAPA-016 §10-§12, not used); CAPA-014 §8.1-§8.4 and §11; CAPA-015 §10-§11; RELEASE-2026-10-25 notes §7 and §9-§12; PRB-004 §9-§10 with PRB-006/007/008/010 'R' sections; PRB-028..031 §6). PR bodies used where no single record holds the round: #64 (the four items are listed only in the PR #64 body; PRB-001/CAPA-012/CAPA-013 only mention 'after the independent review of PR #62'), #70 (findings split across PRB-020..027 'Review of PR #70' sections; the PR body table is the only complete list, same IDs and labels), the 16 unaddressed capture findings of #69 and L4 (only in the PR #69 body), #74 m8 (only in the PR #74 body). A finding-level 'source' key overrides the round source when the quote comes from another document.

SEVERITY LABELS come from different places: explicit words ('Blocker.', '(blocker)', '(major)', 'Major.', 'minor items', 'Known minor items', 'nit'), ID prefixes (B/M/m/n), or a section verdict that counts by severity ('1 blocker and 3 majors', 'one major and six minor items', 'Two minor findings', '10 minor findings', 'five minor points'). PRB-002 re-review N1-N5 are labelled 'minor points' only in the PR #66 body (label_quote); the record calls N5 'record nits'. CAPA-014 §8.2 M1/M2 are 'minor items' (the M prefix there is not 'major'). #71 re-review R2-R7 are minor only by the verdict 'one major and six minor items'. M-prefixed items without a severity word (#65 M1-M4, #68 M2-M5, #70 M1-M3, #71 M1-M3, #69 M1/M2) are mapped to major by the prefix rule.

NOT SEVERITY: '(clinical safety)' (F08), 'pre-existing' (#69 M3), 'Cosmetic', 'small items', 'Small items', 'Note', 'accepted', HAZ ids are kept in severity_as_written only. Problem-report severities (SPR-001 Critical/Major/Minor, proposed by the authoring agent in PRB/CAPA records and in the PR #71 table, e.g. PRB-004 Critical, PRB-010 Major) are a different scheme and were not used. Capture findings later received such PRB severities in #70/#71 (e.g. F21 -> PRB-020 Critical proposed; #71: PRB-004 Critical, PRB-005/006 Major, PRB-007/008/009 Minor).

BLOCKING STATUS vs LABEL: the four capture findings fixed in #69 (F08, F09, F10, F04) are unlabelled per finding, but the record says as a group 'so they block the release' (verdict_quote of 69-capture-1). A second coder may prefer to code F08-F10 as blocker; this coding keeps 'unlabelled' per the rule 'do not reinterpret severity'.

REVIEWER IDENTITY: only PRB-002 §6 states that the independent reviewer is an AI agent (reviewer_quote). Other rounds called 'independent review', 're-review', 'final check' or 'last check' are coded 'independent agent session' as the sources present them as rounds of the same independent-review process; the reviewer is not named. PRB-004 §9 says the #71 review report was 'kept by the coordinator'. 'Coordinator' = the coordinating agent session (other). Capture sessions are the app/film capture walk-throughs (mstool-film CAPTURES.md).

NOT DOUBLE-COUNTED (carried, still open): #67 final check 'R1 (still forgeable)' (from 67-review-3); #68 review 2 'B1, M3 and M4 only partly closed' (from 68-review-1). Listed under carried_over_not_counted. The new IDs raised for the incomplete fixes ARE counted: #68 N1 (re-expresses the B1 residual) and N3 (corrects the M4 claim); #65 N1 and N4 (incomplete m9 fix); #69 B1 (F08 still reachable) and R1/R2 (guard gaps); #67 'R2 (accepted)' (new residual cases of the closed R2).

SAME DEFECT FOUND BY TWO CHANNELS, counted once in each round: F12 (69-capture-1) = item 1 of 69-review-1 (so #69 has 46 coded findings but 45 distinct defects). The '#71 re-review: the fallback colour' section of RELEASE-2026-10-25 notes §11 is #71 re-review R5 (counted once, under #71; the fix landed in both #69 and #71). #69 L1/L2 were carried into #74 as PRB-030/PRB-031 and the RC-047 AI-draft gap as PRB-029; they are not counted as #74 findings. addressed_in_pr: true = fixed in that PR (code, test or a document correction that resolves the finding); false = left open, accepted as residual, or only recorded as a known limit (e.g. #65 m7/m11/m12, #67 R2 (accepted), #67 M1 recorded as merge note and applied later in #69, #69 L1-L3 and the 16 deferred capture findings, #71 small items/Note, #74 m10); null = finding content not stated (#74 m8).

DATES: taken from section headings or PR text. #69 last check has no date in the sources (commit 33f9425 that records it is dated 2026-10-30). #66 re-review uses the date of the §6 heading (2026-10-24).

EVIDENCE BASE: the GitHub snapshot has no formal reviews and no PR comments for #64-#75 (formal_reviews and comments are empty); every review round is known only from the agent-written PR bodies and records.
